title: make the base test command green
body: Outcome: the repository's own test command exits 0 on a clean checkout of the base.

Why: adoption found a red base: red base: the repository's own test command `php tests/shim.php src/get_in.php tests/GetInTest.php` exits 1 on the clean outside/php-red tree, so the Stop gate cannot pass it; make it pass (install the dependencies) and rerun. FAIL igorw\GetInTest::testAssocIn #4 ran 23, failed 1
Files: the files the failing test names (run the test command).
